reason: Section 13 states that examinations for surveyor-in-training admission or practice as a New Brunswick land surveyor are held at places and times determined by the Board.

proposedGroups.title: Times and places for admission examinations
proposedGroups.reason: Section 13 states that examinations for surveyor-in-training admission or practice as a New Brunswick land surveyor are held at places and times determined by the Board.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Know who sets the timing and location of admission examinations.

focusSelections.evidenceText: 13 Examination of candidates for admission as a surveyor - in - training, or to practice as a New Brunswick land surveyor, shall be held at such places and times as the Board shall determine.

reason: Section 14 states that the Board meets at the places and times it determines.

proposedGroups.title: Board meeting times and places
proposedGroups.reason: Section 14 states that the Board meets at the places and times it determines.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Know that the Board controls its own meeting schedule and location.

focusSelections.evidenceText: 14 The Board shall meet as such places and time as it shall determine. REGISTRATION

reason: Subsection 15(1) allows registration as a land surveyor for applicants who are Canadian citizens, meet education and surveyor-in-training requirements, provide good-character evidence, and pay prescribed fees.

proposedGroups.title: Registration requirements for land surveyors
proposedGroups.reason: Subsection 15(1) allows registration as a land surveyor for applicants who are Canadian citizens, meet education and surveyor-in-training requirements, provide good-character evidence, and pay prescribed fees.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Identify the citizenship, education, training, character, and fee conditions for land surveyor registration.

reason: Subsection 15(2) allows an applicant lacking the education condition to apply to the Board and lets Council consider registration after written Board certification that the condition has been met.

proposedGroups.title: Board certification of education requirements
proposedGroups.reason: Subsection 15(2) allows an applicant lacking the education condition to apply to the Board and lets Council consider registration after written Board certification that the condition has been met.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Understand the route for applicants who initially have not met the educational requirements.

reason: Subsection 15(3) allows non-residents of Canada who belong to a recognized surveying or technical organization to apply to the Board and be considered by Council after Board certification of subsection 15(1) conditions.

proposedGroups.title: Non-resident applicant registration pathway
proposedGroups.reason: Subsection 15(3) allows non-residents of Canada who belong to a recognized surveying or technical organization to apply to the Board and be considered by Council after Board certification of subsection 15(1) conditions.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Know how non-resident applicants connected to recognized organizations may seek registration.

reason: Subsection 15(4) entitles a person meeting all subsection 15(1) conditions except surveyor-in-training requirements to Association membership on Council recommendation, with all rights except practicing land surveying.

proposedGroups.title: Association membership without practice rights
proposedGroups.reason: Subsection 15(4) entitles a person meeting all subsection 15(1) conditions except surveyor-in-training requirements to Association membership on Council recommendation, with all rights except practicing land surveying.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Distinguish Association membership from the right to practice when training requirements are incomplete.

reason: Subsection 16(1) prohibits practicing in New Brunswick as a land surveyor unless registered to practice under the Act.

proposedGroups.title: Registration required to practice land surveying
proposedGroups.reason: Subsection 16(1) prohibits practicing in New Brunswick as a land surveyor unless registered to practice under the Act.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Understand the basic registration prerequisite for practicing land surveying in New Brunswick.

reason: Subsection 16(2) permits partnerships, associations of persons, or corporations to practice land surveying as provided under section 17.

proposedGroups.title: Organizational practice subject to section 17
proposedGroups.reason: Subsection 16(2) permits partnerships, associations of persons, or corporations to practice land surveying as provided under section 17.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Know that organizational practice is permitted only through the section 17 framework.

reason: Subsection 17(1) allows Council to authorize Association members to form, join, belong to, or be employed by partnerships, associations, or corporations for land surveying practice.

proposedGroups.title: Council authorization for survey practice organizations
proposedGroups.reason: Subsection 17(1) allows Council to authorize Association members to form, join, belong to, or be employed by partnerships, associations, or corporations for land surveying practice.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Understand Council's role in authorizing members to practice through organizations.

reason: Subsection 17(2) prohibits members from practicing land surveying through a partnership, association, or corporation unless it holds an Association certificate of authorization, with an employment exception for non-public survey practice.

proposedGroups.title: Certificate required for organizational practice
proposedGroups.reason: Subsection 17(2) prohibits members from practicing land surveying through a partnership, association, or corporation unless it holds an Association certificate of authorization, with an employment exception for non-public survey practice.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Identify when a certificate of authorization is required for organizational land surveying practice.

reason: Subsection 17(3) allows a partnership, association, or corporation to receive a certificate if land surveying is a principal and customary function and the work is done by or under the supervision, direction, and control of a land surveyor present in New Brunswick.

proposedGroups.title: Eligibility for certificates of authorization
proposedGroups.reason: Subsection 17(3) allows a partnership, association, or corporation to receive a certificate if land surveying is a principal and customary function and the work is done by or under the supervision, direction, and control of a land surveyor present in New Brunswick.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Understand the function and supervision conditions for an organization to obtain a certificate of authorization.

reason: Subsection 17(4) requires applications to the Registrar to list partners, members, directors, officers, land surveyors in charge, practice offices, and other information Council requires.

proposedGroups.title: Certificate of authorization application contents
proposedGroups.reason: Subsection 17(4) requires applications to the Registrar to list partners, members, directors, officers, land surveyors in charge, practice offices, and other information Council requires.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Know what information an organization must provide to obtain a certificate of authorization.

reason: Subsection 17(5) requires the applicant or holder of a certificate of authorization to notify the Registrar within thirty days after changes to application particulars take effect.

proposedGroups.title: Notice of changes to authorization application particulars
proposedGroups.reason: Subsection 17(5) requires the applicant or holder of a certificate of authorization to notify the Registrar within thirty days after changes to application particulars take effect.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Understand the ongoing notice duty when certificate application details change.

reason: Subsection 17(6) requires the Registrar to issue a certificate of authorization after subsections 17(3) and 17(4) are met, Council approves the application, and prescribed fees are paid.

proposedGroups.title: Issuing certificates of authorization
proposedGroups.reason: Subsection 17(6) requires the Registrar to issue a certificate of authorization after subsections 17(3) and 17(4) are met, Council approves the application, and prescribed fees are paid.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Know the approval, qualification, application, and fee conditions for certificate issuance.

reason: Subsection 17(7) keeps land surveyors personally responsible for compliance with the Act and subject to professional misconduct or incompetence findings despite practicing through an authorized organization.

proposedGroups.title: Personal responsibility despite organizational practice
proposedGroups.reason: Subsection 17(7) keeps land surveyors personally responsible for compliance with the Act and subject to professional misconduct or incompetence findings despite practicing through an authorized organization.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Understand why organizational practice does not remove an individual land surveyor's professional responsibility.

reason: Subsection 17(8) allows the Discipline Committee to reprimand a certificate holder or suspend or revoke its certificate for Act breaches or conduct that would be misconduct or incompetence by an individual member.

proposedGroups.title: Discipline for certificate holders
proposedGroups.reason: Subsection 17(8) allows the Discipline Committee to reprimand a certificate holder or suspend or revoke its certificate for Act breaches or conduct that would be misconduct or incompetence by an individual member.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Know the disciplinary consequences available against holders of certificates of authorization.

reason: Subsection 17(9) primarily incorporates sections 20 to 25, with modifications, for organizations practicing land surveying under subsection 17(1).
Subsection 18(1) requires the Registrar to maintain a register of all persons authorized to practice land surveying under the Act.

proposedGroups.title: Registrar's duty to maintain the practice register
proposedGroups.reason: Subsection 18(1) requires the Registrar to maintain a register of all persons authorized to practice land surveying under the Act.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Understand the Registrar's duty to keep the register of authorized land surveyors.
